description: This file contains utility functions and validation routines for grouped matrix multiplication (GEMM) operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including stride checks, tensor creation, input validation, and fallback implementations for grouped matrix multiplications.

methods.name: check_valid_strides_and_return_transposed
methods.description: Checks tensor strides for validity and determines if the tensor is transposed based on stride patterns.

methods.name: create_grouped_gemm_output_tensor
methods.description: Creates an output tensor for grouped GEMM operations with proper size and stride, considering data alignment.

methods.name: _grouped_mm_validate_inputs
methods.description: Validates input tensors for grouped matrix multiplication, including dtype, dimensions, strides, and optional parameters.

methods.name: _resolve_grouped_mm_out_dtype
methods.description: Determines the output dtype for grouped GEMM, ensuring it matches the input tensor's dtype.

methods.name: _grouped_mm_fallback
methods.description: Provides a fallback implementation for grouped matrix multiplication when optimized paths are unavailable.
